name: leaks
description: Find where your Claude Code week went and fix it: /leaks ranks the avoidable spend in your transcripts, a strip above the prompt flags a leak while it happens, and /compact-at sets an auto-compact point for one session. Works in the desktop app.

warn_at.title: Warn past this many context tokens
warn_at.description: The strip above the prompt flags a session whose context is past this size: every turn re-reads all of it.
